_readme: SERVER-ONLY. Per-copy MEASURED US landed cost (USD) per book SKU, for the sale metadata net_usd (storeEngine.bookSaleMetadata). Lives apart from book-skus.json because that file is imported by src/lib/order-pricing.ts, which ships in the browser bundle: a cost there reached every buyer's browser (intl-handling.test 'client bundle ... carries no cost'). Never import this from client code. Sources: who-am-i (Kevin 2026-11-13), SMP books pmpublish smp-books-landed-20261113 (US column).
